text: The timing of your symptoms following the initiation of captopril is highly suspicious for an adverse drug reaction. While captopril can rarely cause bullous pemphigoid, it is also known to cause severe mucocutaneous reactions like Stevens-Johnson Syndrome (SJS) or Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis (TEN). Have you noticed any skin peeling, fever, or swollen lymph nodes recently? REQUEST TEST: CBC and Liver_Function_Tests. REQUEST IMAGES: Request clinical photos of the forearm and oral lesions to assess for epidermal detachment.
